submission.name: Shuttle Workshop 001
submission.tagline: A synthetic weekend tool for commuters to track shuttle delays and find a route.
submission.inspiration: A fictional team wanted clearer support for commuters.
submission.what_it_does: Commuters use a shuttle dashboard to track shuttle delays and find a route. A secondary databricks feature uses Databricks stores rows in Delta tables and queries notebook aggregates. A optional financial feature uses the financial fraud classifier reads transactions and flags suspicious payments. A central elevenlabs feature uses ElevenLabs API receives text and returns spoken guidance. The working core is unreliable under repeated requests.
submission.how_we_built_it: React sends form inputs to FastAPI. The backend reads records, stores sample data in PostgreSQL and passes results to React, which renders the dashboard. A secondary databricks feature uses Databricks stores rows in Delta tables and queries notebook aggregates. A optional financial feature uses the financial fraud classifier reads transactions and flags suspicious payments. A central elevenlabs feature uses ElevenLabs API receives text and returns spoken guidance.
submission.challenges_we_ran_into: The flow works intermittently; repeated requests can lose state and need a restart.
submission.accomplishments: Connected a narrow core flow with known reliability gaps.
submission.what_we_learned: We learned to describe data flow and make scope limits explicit.
submission.whats_next: Future work: broader testing, live integrations and accessibility improvements.
